title: Import of the openai/math 003 zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 into the Brockian corpus
statement: Audit the Lean formalization of openai/math family 003 (every Dirichlet L-function, including ζ, is zero-free on Re s > 7/8; commit adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a), then import it through a single Mathlib-only trust boundary: ζ_B(s) = (1 − 5^{−s}) ζ(s) is zero-free on Re s > 7/8, the four L(s, χ mod 5) are zero-free there, and every zero of ζ_B in the critical strip has 1/8 ≤ Re ρ ≤ 7/8. The external theorem enters only as a hypothesis of a θ-parametrised transfer (θ = 1 Mathlib, θ = 7/8 external, θ = 1/2 RH); never as an axiom.

source.citation: OpenAI, 'The Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis: A Zero-Free Half-Plane Re(s) > 7/8' (2026-09-30) and 'Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros' (2026-10-01); Lean comparator challenges QuasiRiemannHypothesis.lean, DirichletSevenEighths.lean

criteria: Mathlib-only transfer kernel-checked at lean-4.32.0 by CI (check_lean_modules.py), then AXLE-attested
external 003 closure kernel-checked inside openai/math (Mode B in formal/QuasiRH003/Import003.lean): lake build + #print axioms + comparator
statement fidelity: challenge statements are against Mathlib riemannZeta / DirichletCharacter.LFunction with zero custom definitions
provenance tag ⟨ext: openai/math 003 @ adc7f124⟩ attached to every consumer theorem

notes: Static audit done 2026-10-07: 2,924-module / 489k-line closure, zero sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide, no metaprogramming; pins verified upstream. Three provenance findings travel with the result: (1) the PNT+ 'compatibility patch' creates 47 files absent upstream incl. the whole SiegelZeros/ support (PNT+-derived, Cipollina/Kebekus); (2) PNT+ Wiener.lean is replaced by a trimmed port; (3) the Hecke statement rests on a ~150-line definition in the challenge file. Not formalized by 003: the 11/12 alternate proof (weaker half-plane, human-edited) and the prime-distribution applications ψ(x;q,a) — so ψ(x;5,a) = x/4 + O(x^{7/8+ε}) stays paper-level. The Siegel theorem as formalized is implied by the 7/8 Dirichlet theorem (c = log(3)/8) but its proof shares 0 modules with the 7/8 closure. Status is CONDITIONAL until Mode B runs; the Mathlib-only half becomes PROVED on CI + AXLE independently of 003.
